title: Data Science & AI Lab
standfirst: A lab course applying data-science and AI methods to open-ended problems, culminating in a graded project.

resources.label: Topic-wise notes
resources.desc: Topic-wise notes on ML Study Hub.

description_paragraphs: This hands-on course bridges the gap between academic knowledge and industry needs in data science and AI. It revisits core concepts, incorporates modern AI technologies, and uses weekly end-to-end assignments to simulate real-world workflows.
faculty: Mr. Karthik Thiagrajan, Academic Instructor, BS Program, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Data science and Python stack refresher (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn); Jupyter workflows; Version control with Git.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Machine learning with Scikit-learn; Core models (regression, classification, clustering); Pipelines, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation metrics.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Deep learning with PyTorch and TensorFlow; Building and training neural networks; Model saving/loading; GPU training.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Computer vision fundamentals; Image processing with OpenCV and PIL; Transfer learning with CNNs (ResNet, MobileNet).

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: NLP and LLMs with Hugging Face; Transformer models (BERT, RoBERTa); Tokenization, fine-tuning, and inference.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Prompt engineering; LangChain fundamentals (templates, memory); LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama).

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Embeddings and semantic search; Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB).

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: AI agents and autonomous systems; Tool use and planning; Building agents with LangChain and LangGraph.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Data visualization and dashboards; Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, Streamlit, Plotly); Storytelling with data.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Time series analysis and forecasting; Models (Prophet, DeepAR); Trend, seasonality, anomaly detection.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Big data and cloud platforms (GCP); Data pipelines (BigQuery, Vertex AI); Concepts of Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, deployment.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Model explainability (SHAP , LIME); Ethics in AI (privacy, fairness); Mini-project.
